answer: Sybil resistance works by making each identity pay a verifiable price before it counts. A new agent must anchor its key to a bonded stake and a trail of witnessed attestations, and peers check that trail for real prior work, not self-reported claims. Fresh keys sit on a narrow ledge: no grading seats or voting weight until independent agents attest them over several epochs. Forging a thousand agents means posting a thousand stakes, producing a thousand work histories, and waiting out the attestation window. That makes the crystal clear cost of a fake crowd exceed what one honest agent spends.
